skill.name: joseon-sillok-search
skill.description: Search Joseon Dynasty Annals records from the official sillok.history.go.kr site with keyword search plus optional king/year narrowing.
skill.summary: Find official Joseon Annals records by keyword, ruler, and year, with source links and article excerpts.
skill.author: nomadamas

security_audit.summary: All 22 static alerts are false positives: expected HTTPS access, browser version text, HTML entity decoding, Markdown fences, and readable Korean documentation. No evidence found of credential theft, hidden code, or malicious prompt injection in the reviewed files. Separate contextual risks include mutable remote CLI execution, delegated instructions, and an update command affecting installations beyond this search skill.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md loads executable code and primary instructions through a mutable npm major-version selector.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the reviewed instructions and helper locally; otherwise pin an exact CLI release, verify provenance, and require approval before remote execution.

remediation.issue: The documented update command targets the CLI and every coding-agent skill installation, beyond the requested research task.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic update guidance from the search workflow; expose updates separately with explicit consent, a scoped change list, and rollback instructions.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable Remote CLI Execution and Instruction Delegation
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md says, "Run this and follow its output as the primary instructions for this skill" before invoking npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0. The mutable major-version selector can execute a later package release without an installation prompt, extending trust beyond the reviewed snapshot.

content.value_statement: Finding relevant Joseon records requires searching historical terminology and checking source pages. This skill collects official keyword results, ruler and year filters, source links, and article excerpts.
actual_capabilities: Search the official archive by keyword in Korean translated text or original text.
Normalize supported Korean ruler names and filter results by ruler.
Filter results by Gregorian year inferred from reign metadata.
Collect article titles, summaries, official links, category counts, and result counts.
Extract Korean translations, original article text, classification, and excerpts when detail pages match the expected layout.
Return structured search reports with configurable result limits and HTTP timeouts.
limitations: Requires internet access and the current official HTML layout; site changes or request failures can interrupt retrieval.
Uses keyword matching, not semantic search, embeddings, or a comprehensive local index.
Scans at most 20 search pages, so filtered results may not cover every matching record.
Gregorian years are inferred from ruler accession data and reign labels; verify dates against the source.

use_cases.title: Locate Primary Sources
use_cases.description: Find records about a historical topic and inspect official links, summaries, and excerpts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Classroom Reading
use_cases.description: Gather a small set of ruler-specific records for lessons, checking each source before assigning readings.

use_cases.title: Compare Article Texts
use_cases.description: Retrieve Korean translations and original text for selected records to support close reading.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the Joseon Annals for [keyword]. Return up to five records with official links, summaries, and excerpts.

prompt_templates.title: Narrow by Ruler
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] under [Korean ruler name]. Return up to three records and state the applied ruler filter.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Historical Year
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] under [Korean ruler name] in Gregorian year [year]. Include official links and note that year matching uses inferred metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Modes
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [keyword] separately with types k and w, using [ruler] and a five-result limit. Compare returned records and identify pagination limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced translated and original text comparison

output_examples.input: Search an unmatched keyword and report an empty result.
output_examples.output: Illustrative empty-result response: No matching records were returned. No article links or excerpts are available for this query.

output_examples.input: Search for a historical keyword when the archive cannot be reached.
output_examples.output: Illustrative failure response: The official archive request failed. No records were verified, and no historical results were inferred.

best_practices: Use precise historical keywords and confirm each selected record through its official article link.
Verify inferred Gregorian years and distinguish returned records from the archive's overall result count.
Review and approve remote CLI execution separately; prefer a verified exact release and keep unrelated updates outside the search workflow.
anti_patterns: Treating an empty result as proof that no relevant historical record exists.
Presenting short excerpts or inferred dates as complete, independently verified historical conclusions.
Running broad skill updates automatically while performing a source lookup.

faq.question: Which archive does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches the official Joseon Dynasty Annals website at sillok.history.go.kr using public search and article HTML pages.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: No API key is required. The helper needs Python 3 and internet access; the documented CLI route also needs Node.js 18 or later.

faq.question: Can it search both translations and original text?
faq.answer: Yes. Search type k targets Korean translated text, while type w targets original text.

faq.question: How do ruler and year filters work?
faq.answer: Supported Korean ruler aliases are normalized. Year filtering uses Gregorian years inferred from reign labels and accession data, so source verification remains necessary.

faq.question: Are results exhaustive?
faq.answer: No. The helper stops after enough matching records or 20 search pages, and exact keyword searches can miss related terminology.

faq.question: Does the documented setup execute remote code?
faq.answer: Yes. The npx commands can fetch and execute a mutable CLI release. Review its provenance and approve execution separately from unrelated updates.
